facts.excerpt: Six Christmas Markets in the historic town

facts.fact: The Ancienne Douane market is arranged around the Schwendi fountain and extends toward the Koïfhus.
facts.excerpt: this square has around fifty chalets arranged around the imposing Schwendi fountain

facts.fact: Petite Venise is described as a family-oriented Christmas market area alongside the Lauch.
facts.excerpt: The original alignment of the half-timbered houses on either side of the River Lauch gave this emblematic area of Colmar its name, la Petite Venise
